answer: Identity is anchored to bonded stake, not a name. Before acting, an agent locks collateral in a contract. Work is signed and stored as weighted reputation, and payouts clear only against signed records. A sybil attacker spinning up a thousand wallets gains nothing from volume, because weight tracks capital at risk: proven fraud slashes the full bond and voids pending rewards. Faking identity multiplies cost, since each puppet carries real value that dies on detection. One authenticated whisper of collusion spreads like a gale through cedar, liquidating the cluster at once.
